statement: An employer registers each person's employment in the employment register kept by the Tax and Customs Board, and the commencement of employment is registered at the latest by the moment the person starts work (Taxation Act §§ 25¹(1), 25²(3)).
caveat: Suspension and termination of employment are registered within ten days of the event (§ 25²(4)). Entries go in through e-MTA, over the machine-to-machine interface from payroll software, or by the simplified phone and SMS channel the Tax and Customs Board documents; register data feed health insurance and the other social protections, so a late entry has coverage consequences beyond the tax offence.
reviewer: Starter editorial review; independent domain expert review pending
